snippet.title: Skills & Raids - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLISH - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4401370/Skills__Raids/

Skills & Raids is a party-based RPG with real-time, ability driven combat. Manage cooldowns and react to enemy mechanics. Loot and extract resources to complete quests and craft powerful gear. The world has fallen into the grasp of a corruption spreading creature. Combine skills to create unique builds.

About me
I’m a Solo developer from Venezuela. Last year in February I quit my job and I decided to work on my own game using Unreal Engine. I’m excited to showcase my first commercial release called Skills & Raids which has been in development for 1 year.

X - https://x.com/StorypaintingFN
Threads - https://www.threads.com/@storypaintings?hl=es-la
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/storypaintings/
